label: Constraint tables
subgoals: Find the constraint group on the data pin with its related clock
Check the template for which index is data and which is clock transition
Read the setup or hold value at the grid point

label: Setup slack from a constraint
subgoals: Subtract the setup time from the capture clock arrival for the required time
Subtract the data arrival from the required time for slack
Use the clock pin's slew when looking up the constraint

label: Hold slack and other checks
subgoals: Add the hold time to the clock arrival and compare with the earliest data
Preserve negative hold values from the table
Treat recovery and removal as setup and hold for reset release
